AZAN AUDIO MAPPING

The app now includes two user-supplied MP3 files:
- app/src/main/res/raw/azan_001.mp3 = "001 azan.mp3"
  Used for: Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha
- app/src/main/res/raw/azan_002.mp3 = "002 azan.mp3"
  Used for: Fajr

The existing per-prayer Azan enable/disable settings are preserved.
If Azan is disabled globally or for a particular prayer, that prayer will not start audio.
No synthesized tone or fallback ringtone is used.
